task.title: Agree the hosted-app plan with the repo owner
task.description:
## Why
The hosted site is a large addition to a repo someone else owns, and it needs settings only a repo admin can change. Agreeing the shape first avoids rework.

## Steps
1. Share the plan with the owner: a TypeScript app in a new `web/` folder that runs on Cloudflare Workers, with the Python CLI kept as the reference version until the port matches it.
2. Confirm the hosted app lives in this repo rather than a separate one.
3. Confirm who will own the team Cloudflare account and the production deploy secrets. Adding GitHub secrets needs repo admin rights, which the current contributor account does not have.
4. Confirm the public-data rule still applies: no league ids, rosters, manager names or run output in the repo.

## Done when
- The owner has agreed to the `web/` layout and to keeping the Python CLI during the port.
- It is written down who adds the production secrets and who owns the team Cloudflare account.
